digest.component_or_area: retrigger gate / code review blocker handling
propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all findings including bugfix-size-attestation blocks, but the fix for bugfix-size-attestation is ticket attestation (outside the diff), not code change, making the blanket refusal wrong
when a change has only a bugfix-size-attestation block and the ticket carries a current accepted plan-review attestation, recheck-review should accept the re-review request instead of refusing
no-code-change patchsets copy the -1 label forward even after attestation is earned on the ticket, trapping changes unlandable without spurious code edits
the retrigger path must verify attestation by reusing the gate's own classifier (bucket_for_verdict returning accepted), reading only bot vote and ticket store, never trusting the requesting comment
blocks containing bugfix-size-attestation plus other findings, or attestations in FLAG_VERDICTS (absent, stale-material, mismatch, invalid) or infra states, must still refuse
